sql: WITH RECURSIVE r(n) AS (SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT n+1 FROM r WHERE n<2 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM r)) SELECT n FROM r
WITH RECURSIVE r(n) AS (SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT (SELECT n FROM r LIMIT 1)+1 FROM r WHERE n<2) SELECT n FROM r
WITH RECURSIVE r(n) AS (SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT n+1 FROM r WHERE n<2 AND n IN(SELECT n FROM r)) SELECT n FROM r
WITH RECURSIVE r(n) AS (SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT 2 WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM r)) SELECT n FROM r
WITH RECURSIVE r(n) AS (SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT (SELECT n FROM r)+1) SELECT n FROM r
WITH RECURSIVE r(n) AS (SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT r.n+1 FROM r JOIN (SELECT 1 AS v) d ON EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM r) WHERE n<2) SELECT n FROM r
WITH RECURSIVE r(n) AS (SELECT 1 UNION ALL (SELECT n+1 FROM r WHERE n<2 ORDER BY (SELECT n FROM r LIMIT 1))) SELECT n FROM r
WITH RECURSIVE r(n) AS (SELECT (SELECT n FROM r LIMIT 1) UNION ALL SELECT n+1 FROM r WHERE n<2) SELECT n FROM r
WITH RECURSIVE r(n) AS (SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT n+1 FROM r WHERE n<2 AND EXISTS(WITH x AS(SELECT n FROM r) SELECT 1)) SELECT n FROM r
WITH RECURSIVE r(n) AS (SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT n+1 FROM r WHERE n<2 AND EXISTS(WITH r AS(SELECT 8 AS n) SELECT n FROM r)) SELECT n FROM r
WITH RECURSIVE r(n) AS (SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT n+1 FROM r WHERE n<2 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1)) SELECT n FROM r
